name: J201
description: Low-pinch-off N-channel JFET prized in guitar pedals for tube-like soft clipping and high-impedance buffers. The through-hole TO-92 part is increasingly scarce; the MMBFJ201 SMD version is the common substitute.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: D-S-G (pin 1 drain on the left).

typical_application: JFET amp-sim gain stages (Fetzer Valve, AMZ), high-impedance instrument buffers, soft-clipping stages. Self-bias with a source resistor.
gotchas: very low IDSS and pinch-off; parameters scatter widely, so bias circuits often need trimming per device
MMBFJ201 SMD substitute has a DIFFERENT pinout than the TO-92; check the package before swapping
depletion-mode: conducts at Vgs=0, needs negative gate-source voltage to pinch off
